basic_details.job_title: KHADC Law Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council (KHADC), Shillong, Meghalaya, has invited applications for the post of Law Officer under Advt No. DC.I/53/2025-2026/11. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch.

qualification.education_qualification: Law Graduate from any recognised institution/university, cleared the All India Bar Examination (AIBE), with a minimum of seven (7) years practical experience as Advocate practising in a Court of Law
qualification.details: Qualification: Law Graduate from any recognised institution/university, cleared the All India Bar Examination (AIBE), with a minimum of seven (7) years practical experience as Advocate practising in a Court of Law Experience: Minimum of seven (7) years practical experience as Advocate practising in a Court of Law Age limit: 25 to 37 years (as on 1 July 2026) | Other conditions: | Must be able to speak, read and write Khasi Language Must furnish a valid contact number, WhatsApp number and email address

pattern_table.Subject: General English, General Knowledge, Sixth Schedule to the Constitution of India, Customary land laws and KHADC Acts and Rules, Meghalaya Building Bye-Laws
Legal drafting, Contempt of Court's Act, Interpretation of Statutes, Administrative Law, Constitutional Law, CPC/CrPC/BNSS, Evidence Act/BSA, IPC/BNS, Family Law, Service Laws

exam_pattern.details: Candidates shall download and produce a hard copy of the Admit Card at the examination centre. No TA/DA shall be admissible for the written examination and personal interview.

how_to_apply: Complete the application in standard form in all respects.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents and three recent passport-size photographs.
Attach a Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch.
Submit the application at Room No. 317 (Personnel and Administrative Department), KHADC, Shillong.
In-service applicants apply through proper channel with an NOC.
important_instructions: There will be no Ineligibility List; ineligible candidates are summarily rejected without further information Original certificates must be produced for verification whenever required; failure may result in disqualification

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 15 December 2026 Vacancies: 1 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Fee: All candidates: Rs. 500 (non-refundable) Pay: ₹55,500 - ₹1,16,200 PM (Level-17) plus usual allowances Age limit: 25 to 37 years (as on 1 July 2026) Place: Shillong

content_sections.heading: KHADC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. DC.I/53/2025-2026/11 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download KHADC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Law Graduate from any recognised institution/university, cleared the All India Bar Examination (AIBE), with a minimum of seven (7) years practical experience as Advocate practising in a Court of Law Experience: Minimum of seven (7) years practical experience as Advocate practising in a Court of Law Age limit: 25 to 37 years (as on 1 July 2026) Other conditions: Must be able to speak, read and write Khasi Language Must furnish a valid contact number, WhatsApp number and email address

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for KHADC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who are not of the Scheduled Tribe Community of the State of Meghalaya Applications received after the last date Incomplete applications or those with incorrect or misleading information

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch.

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Application Forms (during office hours)

content_sections.heading: How Will KHADC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Examination (two papers of 100 marks each, 3 hours each) Personal Interview Admit Cards issued in soft copy through registered email and WhatsApp; hard copy to be produced at the examination centre Candidates fulfilling essential qualifications called for written examination Written examination of two papers of 100 marks each, 3 hours each Personal interview, attended at candidate's own expense

content_sections.heading: KHADC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shall download and produce a hard copy of the Admit Card at the examination centre. No TA/DA shall be admissible for the written examination and personal interview.

rows.subject: General English, General Knowledge, Sixth Schedule to the Constitution of India, Customary land laws and KHADC Acts and Rules, Meghalaya Building Bye-Laws
Legal drafting, Contempt of Court's Act, Interpretation of Statutes, Administrative Law, Constitutional Law, CPC/CrPC/BNSS, Evidence Act/BSA, IPC/BNS, Family Law, Service Laws

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in standard form, completed in all respects Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents Three recent passport-size photographs Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch No Objection Certificate from the concerned authority (for applicants in Central/State Government or PSU service)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KHADC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Complete the application in standard form in all respects. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents and three recent passport-size photographs. Attach a Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of the Executive Committee, KHADC, Shillong, payable at Meghalaya Rural Bank, Iewduh Branch. Submit the application at Room No. 317 (Personnel and Administrative Department), KHADC, Shillong. Submit by 15-12-2026 during office hours. In-service applicants apply through proper channel with an NOC.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: There will be no Ineligibility List; ineligible candidates are summarily rejected without further information Original certificates must be produced for verification whenever required; failure may result in disqualification

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KHADC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KHADC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Law Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KHADC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Standard form) and send it to Room No. 317 (Personnel and Administrative Department), KHADC, Shillong, by by hand, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs. 500 (non-refundable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 25 to 37 years (as on 1 July 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ₹55,500 - ₹1,16,200 PM (Level-17) plus usual allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Law Graduate from any recognised institution/university, cleared the All India Bar Examination (AIBE), with a minimum of seven (7) years practical experience as Advocate practising in a Court of Law.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be able to speak, read and write Khasi Language. Must furnish a valid contact number, WhatsApp number and email address.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not of the Scheduled Tribe Community of the State of Meghalaya. Applications received after the last date. Incomplete applications or those with incorrect or misleading information.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Examination (two papers of 100 marks each, 3 hours each). Personal Interview. Admit Cards issued in soft copy through registered email and WhatsApp; hard copy to be produced at the examination centre. Candidates fulfilling essential qualifications called for written examination.
